'''Surgeon's Variant''' was a tactic in the game [[Firepath/Legends|Firepath]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the strategy was thought to be used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] against [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Dhol]] during his [[Mission to Cheelit|mission]] to [[Cheelit/Legends|Cheelit]].
